facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure once the supply caravans flow again. Sir Phidipaldi offered it as payment to recruit the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda, so it is at least partly pledged to them.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not say whether the note was handed over to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda or only promised to them, nor how much of it each was promised.
